fields.Name: T116 - Dashboard Add Part In Edit Mode
fields.Description: Exercises the edit-mode part-management path (openAddPartDialog + mj-add-panel-dialog fed by the viewer's part types) — dashboard-composition UI that exists only inside the dashboard editor, unrelated to any entity form or grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open Data Explorer, then the Dashboards section. Create a new dashboard (it opens in edit mode) or open one you own and click Edit to enter edit mode. In the edit-mode header on the left there is an 'Add Part' button (a plus icon). Click it and confirm an 'Add Panel'/part-picker dialog opens listing available part types you could add to the dashboard. Success is the Add Part dialog rendering with selectable part types — you do NOT need to fully add and configure a panel. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Entering edit mode on an owned dashboard shows an 'Add Part' button in the header
Clicking 'Add Part' opens a part/panel picker dialog listing available part types
The dialog presents selectable options (or a clear empty state if no part types are configured)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
